name: RunInstances

parameters.help_en: The instance type
parameters.help_zh: 实例规格
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
实例付费方式。取值：
PrePaid：预付费，包年包月。
PostPaid：按量付费
parameters.name: instance_charge_type

parameters.help_en: The image ID. This parameter is not required for ARM-based instances but is required for other instance types
parameters.help_zh: 镜像ID。arm版卡不能填，其他类型规格必填
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en:
The region code.
Required for region-level scheduling. Ignored for edge zone-level scheduling
parameters.help_zh:
地区Code。
区域级调度时必填，节点级调度时无效
parameters.name: net_district_code

parameters.help_en:
The Internet service provider (ISP).
Required for region-level scheduling.</br>
For edge zone-level scheduling in multi-ISP scenarios, if this parameter is not specified, instances are created based on the ISPs available in the edge zone. For example, if both China Mobile and China Unicom are available, two instances with different ISPs are created.</br>
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2637461.html to query ISP information for edge zones
parameters.help_zh:
运营商。
区域级调度时必填。</br>
在节点级调度时如果是节点存在多运营商场景时，如果不输入运营商则会按节点的运营商进行生产，如有移动、联通两个运营商，则生产出来的实例有两个ISP。</br>您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2637461.html获取节点运营商信息
parameters.name: carrier

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling level. Specifies whether to perform edge zone-level or region-level scheduling. Valid values:

Big: geographic area
Middle: province
Small: city
Region: edge zone
parameters.help_zh:
调度层级。通过该字段来执行节点级调度或者区域调度。取值：

Big：大区
Middle：省份
Small：城市
Region：节点
parameters.name: schedule_area_level

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling strategy. Valid values:

Concentrate: centralized scheduling
Disperse: distributed scheduling

For edge zone-level scheduling, set this parameter to Concentrate. For region-level scheduling, select a value as needed
parameters.help_zh:
调度策略。取值：

Concentrate：集中
Disperse：分散

节点级调度时，为Concentrate；区域级调度时，按客户需求选择
parameters.name: scheduling_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The edge zone ID.

Required for edge zone-level scheduling. Ignored for region-level scheduling
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。

节点级调度时必填，区域级调度时无效
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance password.

You must specify at least one of the following parameters: Password, KeyPairName, and PasswordInherit
parameters.help_zh:
实例密码。

Password、KeyPairName、PasswordInherit至少填入一个
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
The name of the key pair.
You must specify at least one of the following parameters: Password, KeyPairName, and PasswordInherit
parameters.help_zh:
密钥对名称。
Password、KeyPairName、PasswordInherit至少填入一个
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth billing method. Valid values:
BandwidthByDay: daily peak bandwidth
95BandwidthByMonth: monthly 95th percentile bandwidth

You can select a billing method during the initial purchase. Subsequent requests use the initially selected billing method by default
parameters.help_zh:
带宽计费方式。取值：
BandwidthByDay：日峰值带宽
95BandwidthByMonth：月95峰值带宽

如果是第一次新购时可以进行选择计费方式，后续此字段值会根据第一次所选择的计费方式进行默认处理
parameters.name: internet_charge_type

fields.help_en: The size of the system cloud disk. Unit: GiB
fields.name: size

fields.help_en: The category of the system cloud disk
fields.name: category

parameters.help_en: The system cloud disk specifications
parameters.help_zh: 系统盘规格
parameters.name: system_disk

element_fields.help_en: The size of the data cloud disk. Unit: GiB
element_fields.name: size

element_fields.help_en:
The disk category. Valid values:
cloud_efficiency: ultra disk
cloud_ssd: all-flash disk
local_hdd: local HDD
local_ssd: local SSD
element_fields.help_zh:
磁盘种类。取值：
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘
cloud_ssd：全闪云盘
local_hdd：本地HDD盘
local_ssd：本地SSD盘
element_fields.name: category

element_fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to encrypt the cloud disk. Valid values:

true: yes

false (default): no
element_fields.help_zh:
是否加密云盘。取值范围：

true：是

false（默认值）：否
element_fields.name: encrypted

element_fields.help_en:
The ID of the Key Management Service (KMS) key used to encrypt the cloud disk. Valid values:

true: yes

false (default): no

If Encrypted is set to true and KMSKeyId is left empty, the default service key is used
element_fields.help_zh:
云盘使用的KMS密钥ID。取值范围：

true：是

false（默认值）：否

如果Encrypted置为true，KMSKeyId为空时则使用服务默认密钥
element_fields.name: kms_key_id

parameters.help_en: The data cloud disk specifications
parameters.help_zh: 数据盘规格
parameters.name: data_disk

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the resource.

If PeriodUnit is set to Day, Period can only be set to 3.

If PeriodUnit is set to Month, Period can be set to 1-9 or 12
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长。

如果PeriodUnit取值为Day时，则Period仅可设置为3。

如果PeriodUnit取值为Month时，则Period可设置为1-9,12
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The maximum outbound public bandwidth. If this parameter is set to a value greater than 0, a public IP address is automatically assigned to the instance
parameters.help_zh: 公网最大带宽，如果本参数的值大于0，则自动为实例分配公网IP
parameters.name: internet_max_bandwidth_out

parameters.help_en: The number of instances to create. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 创建的实例数量。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: amount

parameters.help_en:
The network ID.

This parameter is valid only for edge zone-level scheduling. Specifying this parameter for region-level scheduling causes an error. If vSwitch information is not specified, only the validity of the network ID is verified. The actual resources are not provisioned based on this network ID
parameters.help_zh:
网络ID。

只能在节点级调度使用，区域级调度时配置该参数会报错。如果不指定交换机信息时，则只会校验网络ID是否合法，实际资源生产并不以此网络ID为准
parameters.name: net_work_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID.

This parameter is valid only for edge zone-level scheduling. Specifying this parameter for region-level scheduling causes an error
parameters.help_zh:
交换机ID。

只能在节点级调度使用，区域级调度时配置该参数会报错
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The security group ID
parameters.help_zh: 安全组ID
parameters.name: security_id

parameters.help_en: The hostname
parameters.help_zh: 主机名称
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain Chinese characters, English letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

The default value is the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例名称。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、点号（.）或者连字符（-）。

默认值为实例的InstanceId
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to add ordered suffixes to HostName and InstanceName. The suffixes start from 001 and increment sequentially, up to a maximum of 999
parameters.help_zh: 是否为HostName和InstanceName添加有序后缀，有序后缀从001开始递增，最大不能超过999
parameters.name: unique_suffix

parameters.help_en: The user-defined data. Maximum size: 16 KB. You can pass UserData encoded in Base64 format
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大支持16 KB。您可传入UserData信息，UserData以Base64的方式编码
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal
false (default): disables auto-renewal

This parameter is invalid for pay-as-you-go instances
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动续费。取值：

true：自动续费
false：不自动续费（默认）

按量付费时，该参数无效
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The price-based scheduling strategy. Valid values:

PriceHighPriority: prioritize higher prices
PriceLowPriority: prioritize lower prices
parameters.help_zh:
调度价格策略。取值：

PriceHighPriority：优先高价
PriceLowPriority：优先低价
parameters.name: scheduling_price_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The private IP address.
This parameter is valid only for edge zone-level scheduling. Specifying this parameter for region-level scheduling causes an error.
If you specify a private IP address, you can create only one instance. The private IP address takes effect only when both the private IP address and the vSwitch ID are specified
parameters.help_zh:
私网IP地址。
只能在节点级调度使用，区域级调度时配置该参数会报错。
如果指定了私网IP，实例数量只能为1台，且私网IP和交换机ID同时非空时，该私网IP才生效
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:
Month (default): month
Day: day
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长单位。取值：
Month（默认）：按月购买。
Day：按天购买
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable public IP identification. Valid values:

true: enabled

false: disabled

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用公网ipidentification。
取值：

true：启用。

false：不启用

默认值：true
parameters.name: public_ip_identification

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the preset password from the image. Valid values:

true: uses the preset password
false: does not use the preset password

You must specify at least one of the following parameters: Password, KeyPairName, and PasswordInherit
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用镜像预置密码。取值：

true：使用
false：不使用

Password、KeyPairName、PasswordInherit至少填入一个
parameters.name: password_inherit

parameters.help_en:
The instance billing strategy. Valid values:

instance: instance-level billing
If this parameter is not specified, user-level billing is applied by default
parameters.help_zh:
实例计费策略。取值：

instance：实例粒度
不传默认按用户维度
parameters.name: instance_charge_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle for instance compute resources. Only applicable to instance-level pay-as-you-go billing. Valid values:

Day: billed daily

Month: billed monthly
parameters.help_zh:
实例计算资源计费周期，仅支持实例级后付费。
取值

Day：按天计费。

Month：按月计费
parameters.name: billing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The IP version. Valid values:

ipv4 (default): IPv4

ipv6: IPv6

ipv4Andipv6: IPv4 and IPv6 (single-stack)
ipv4Withipv6: IPv4 and IPv6 (dual-stack)
parameters.help_zh:
IP类型。取值：

ipv4（默认值）：IPv4。

ipv6：IPv6。

ipv4Andipv6：IPv4和IPv6(单栈)。
ipv4Withipv6：IPv4和IPv6(双栈)
parameters.name: ip_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use vouchers. Default value: true, which indicates that vouchers are used
parameters.help_zh: 是否使用代金券，默认为使用，即AutoUseCoupon=true
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

element_fields.help_en: The tag value. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh: 标签值。不可超过128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags bound to the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例所绑定的标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The automatic release time for the pay-as-you-go instance. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in UTC+0 format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

If the seconds (`ss`) value is not `00`, the release time is automatically rounded down to the start of the current minute (`mm`).

The earliest release time is one hour after the current time.
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html
parameters.help_zh:
按量付费实例的自动释放时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，使用UTC+0时间。格式为：0。

如果秒（`ss`）取值不是`00`，则自动取为当前分钟（`mm`）开始时。

最短释放时间为当前时间一小时之后
parameters.name: auto_release_time

parameters.help_en:
The bidding strategy for the pay-as-you-go instance. This parameter takes effect only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PostPaid`. Valid values:

NoSpot: regular pay-as-you-go instance
SpotAsPriceGo: system-generated bid that follows the current market price

Default value: NoSpot
parameters.help_zh:
按量付费实例的竞价策略。当参数`InstanceChargeType`取值为`PostPaid`时生效。取值范围：

NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格。

默认值：NoSpot
parameters.name: spot_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The protection period of the spot instance.

Unit: hours
parameters.help_zh:
抢占式实例保护期。

单位：小时
parameters.name: spot_duration

parameters.help_en: The number of randomly generated IPv6 addresses assigned to the primary private ENI
parameters.help_zh: 为私网主网卡指定随机生成的ipv6地址数量
parameters.name: ipv6_address_count

parameters.help_en:
The deletion protection status of the instance. Specifies whether the instance can be released through the console or API operations. Valid values: 

true: enables deletion protection
false: disables deletion protection

Default value: false.

This property applies only to pay-as-you-go instances. It prevents only manual release operations and does not prevent system-triggered releases
parameters.help_zh:
实例释放保护属性，指定是否支持通过控制台或API释放实例。取值范围： 

true：开启实例释放保护。
false：关闭实例释放保护。

默认值：false。

该属性仅适用于按量付费实例，且只能限制手动释放操作，对系统释放操作不生效
parameters.name: deletion_protection

The billing method of the instance. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
v1_parameters.help_zh:
实例付费方式。取值：
PrePaid：预付费，包年包月。
PostPaid：按量付费
v1_parameters.name: InstanceChargeType

v1_parameters.help_en:
The instance name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain Chinese characters, English letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

The default value is the instance ID
v1_parameters.help_zh:
实例名称。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、点号（.）或者连字符（-）。

默认值为实例的InstanceId
v1_parameters.name: InstanceName

v1_parameters.help_en: The instance type
v1_parameters.help_zh: 实例规格
v1_parameters.name: InstanceType

v1_parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth billing method. Valid values:
BandwidthByDay: daily peak bandwidth
95BandwidthByMonth: monthly 95th percentile bandwidth

You can select a billing method during the initial purchase. Subsequent requests use the initially selected billing method by default
v1_parameters.help_zh:
带宽计费方式。取值：
BandwidthByDay：日峰值带宽
95BandwidthByMonth：月95峰值带宽

如果是第一次新购时可以进行选择计费方式，后续此字段值会根据第一次所选择的计费方式进行默认处理
v1_parameters.name: InternetChargeType

v1_parameters.help_en: The maximum outbound public bandwidth. If this parameter is set to a value greater than 0, a public IP address is automatically assigned to the instance
v1_parameters.help_zh: 公网最大带宽，如果本参数的值大于0，则自动为实例分配公网IP
v1_parameters.name: InternetMaxBandwidthOut

v1_parameters.help_en:
The IP version. Valid values:

ipv4 (default): IPv4

ipv6: IPv6

ipv4Andipv6: IPv4 and IPv6 (single-stack)
ipv4Withipv6: IPv4 and IPv6 (dual-stack)
v1_parameters.help_zh:
IP类型。取值：

ipv4（默认值）：IPv4。

ipv6：IPv6。

ipv4Andipv6：IPv4和IPv6(单栈)。
ipv4Withipv6：IPv4和IPv6(双栈)
v1_parameters.name: IpType

v1_parameters.help_en: The number of randomly generated IPv6 addresses assigned to the primary private ENI
v1_parameters.help_zh: 为私网主网卡指定随机生成的ipv6地址数量
v1_parameters.name: Ipv6AddressCount

v1_parameters.help_en:
The name of the key pair.
You must specify at least one of the following parameters: Password, KeyPairName, and PasswordInherit
v1_parameters.help_zh:
密钥对名称。
Password、KeyPairName、PasswordInherit至少填入一个
v1_parameters.name: KeyPairName

v1_parameters.help_en: The launch template ID
v1_parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板ID
v1_parameters.name: LaunchTemplateId

v1_parameters.help_en: The launch template name
v1_parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板名称
v1_parameters.name: LaunchTemplateName

v1_parameters.help_en: The launch template version
v1_parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板版本
v1_parameters.name: LaunchTemplateVersion

v1_parameters.help_en:
The region code.
Required for region-level scheduling. Ignored for edge zone-level scheduling
v1_parameters.help_zh:
地区Code。
区域级调度时必填，节点级调度时无效
v1_parameters.name: NetDistrictCode

v1_parameters.help_en:
The network ID.

This parameter is valid only for edge zone-level scheduling. Specifying this parameter for region-level scheduling causes an error. If vSwitch information is not specified, only the validity of the network ID is verified. The actual resources are not provisioned based on this network ID
v1_parameters.help_zh:
网络ID。

只能在节点级调度使用，区域级调度时配置该参数会报错。如果不指定交换机信息时，则只会校验网络ID是否合法，实际资源生产并不以此网络ID为准
v1_parameters.name: NetWorkId

v1_parameters.help_en:
The instance password.

You must specify at least one of the following parameters: Password, KeyPairName, and PasswordInherit
v1_parameters.help_zh:
实例密码。

Password、KeyPairName、PasswordInherit至少填入一个
v1_parameters.name: Password

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the preset password from the image. Valid values:

true: uses the preset password
false: does not use the preset password

You must specify at least one of the following parameters: Password, KeyPairName, and PasswordInherit
v1_parameters.help_zh:
是否使用镜像预置密码。取值：

true：使用
false：不使用

Password、KeyPairName、PasswordInherit至少填入一个
v1_parameters.name: PasswordInherit

v1_parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the resource.

If PeriodUnit is set to Day, Period can only be set to 3.

If PeriodUnit is set to Month, Period can be set to 1-9 or 12
v1_parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长。

如果PeriodUnit取值为Day时，则Period仅可设置为3。

如果PeriodUnit取值为Month时，则Period可设置为1-9,12
v1_parameters.name: Period

v1_parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:
Month (default): month
Day: day
v1_parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长单位。取值：
Month（默认）：按月购买。
Day：按天购买
v1_parameters.name: PeriodUnit

v1_parameters.help_en:
The private IP address.
This parameter is valid only for edge zone-level scheduling. Specifying this parameter for region-level scheduling causes an error.
If you specify a private IP address, you can create only one instance. The private IP address takes effect only when both the private IP address and the vSwitch ID are specified
v1_parameters.help_zh:
私网IP地址。
只能在节点级调度使用，区域级调度时配置该参数会报错。
如果指定了私网IP，实例数量只能为1台，且私网IP和交换机ID同时非空时，该私网IP才生效
v1_parameters.name: PrivateIpAddress

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable public IP identification. Valid values:

true: enabled

false: disabled

Default value: true
v1_parameters.help_zh:
是否启用公网ipidentification。
取值：

true：启用。

false：不启用

默认值：true
v1_parameters.name: PublicIpIdentification

v1_parameters.help_en:
The scheduling level. Specifies whether to perform edge zone-level or region-level scheduling. Valid values:

Big: geographic area
Middle: province
Small: city
Region: edge zone
v1_parameters.help_zh:
调度层级。通过该字段来执行节点级调度或者区域调度。取值：

Big：大区
Middle：省份
Small：城市
Region：节点
v1_parameters.name: ScheduleAreaLevel

v1_parameters.help_en:
The price-based scheduling strategy. Valid values:

PriceHighPriority: prioritize higher prices
PriceLowPriority: prioritize lower prices
v1_parameters.help_zh:
调度价格策略。取值：

PriceHighPriority：优先高价
PriceLowPriority：优先低价
v1_parameters.name: SchedulingPriceStrategy

v1_parameters.help_en:
The scheduling strategy. Valid values:

Concentrate: centralized scheduling
Disperse: distributed scheduling

For edge zone-level scheduling, set this parameter to Concentrate. For region-level scheduling, select a value as needed
v1_parameters.help_zh:
调度策略。取值：

Concentrate：集中
Disperse：分散

节点级调度时，为Concentrate；区域级调度时，按客户需求选择
v1_parameters.name: SchedulingStrategy

v1_parameters.help_en: The security group ID
v1_parameters.help_zh: 安全组ID
v1_parameters.name: SecurityId

v1_parameters.help_en:
The protection period of the spot instance.

Unit: hours
v1_parameters.help_zh:
抢占式实例保护期。

单位：小时
v1_parameters.name: SpotDuration

v1_parameters.help_en:
The bidding strategy for the pay-as-you-go instance. This parameter takes effect only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PostPaid`. Valid values:

NoSpot: regular pay-as-you-go instance
SpotAsPriceGo: system-generated bid that follows the current market price

Default value: NoSpot
v1_parameters.help_zh:
按量付费实例的竞价策略。当参数`InstanceChargeType`取值为`PostPaid`时生效。取值范围：

NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格。

默认值：NoSpot
v1_parameters.name: SpotStrategy

v1_parameters.help_en: The system cloud disk specifications
v1_parameters.help_zh: 系统盘规格
v1_parameters.name: SystemDisk

v1_parameters.help_en: The tags bound to the instance
v1_parameters.help_zh: 实例所绑定的标签
v1_parameters.name: Tag

v1_parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to add ordered suffixes to HostName and InstanceName. The suffixes start from 001 and increment sequentially, up to a maximum of 999
v1_parameters.help_zh: 是否为HostName和InstanceName添加有序后缀，有序后缀从001开始递增，最大不能超过999
v1_parameters.name: UniqueSuffix

v1_parameters.help_en: The user-defined data. Maximum size: 16 KB. You can pass UserData encoded in Base64 format
v1_parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大支持16 KB。您可传入UserData信息，UserData以Base64的方式编码
v1_parameters.name: UserData

v1_parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID.

This parameter is valid only for edge zone-level scheduling. Specifying this parameter for region-level scheduling causes an error
v1_parameters.help_zh:
交换机ID。

只能在节点级调度使用，区域级调度时配置该参数会报错
v1_parameters.name: VSwitchId
